summary: Iteration 2 testing of new AegisShield features: domain age via RDAP, scan_id, PDF download reports, and Chrome extension zip. Backend: 36/36 pytest passed (21 regression + 15 new). Frontend: Admin login OK; URL scanner shows url-domain-age pill (trusted github => 'well-known trusted domain'; phishing fake domain => 'no registration record') and PdfButton after scan - downloaded a valid PDF (filename aegisshield-report-<id>.pdf). Extension page at /console/extension (sidebar label 'Extension') renders download-extension-btn pointing to {BACKEND}/api/extension.zip and extension-install-steps list. History table shows history-pdf-<id> icon buttons (21 found) and successfully downloaded a PDF. AI and Email scanners also render download-pdf-btn after scan. Extension zip endpoint returns valid MV3 zip with manifest.json/background.js/alarm.js/popup.html/popup.js/icons and __API_BASE__ placeholder correctly replaced. Chat with URL still works (async). scan_id null for anonymous, string(24) for logged-in on url/email always and ai when level!=insufficient.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') (flagged in iter1, not blocking).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True remains (flagged in iter1).
analyzers.py lookup_domain_age caches successes only, errors returned without caching - fine; _AGE_CACHE has no eviction/TTL; low risk for a long-running process but acceptable for current scale.
reports.py build_extension_zip reads all files into memory and re-encodes text; fine for small extension bundle.
Sidebar nav label is 'Scan History' => data-testid is 'nav-scan-history' (not 'nav-history'); review request mentioned 'sidebar nav-extension' which is present and correct.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several admin scans + a fresh registered user to test 404 cross-user PDF access.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_aegis_backend.py (21). New-feature suite: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (15, covers domain_age/scan_id/PDF/extension zip/async chat). Run: python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v. Frontend testids: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn, url-scan-input, url-preset-0..2, url-domain-age, download-pdf-btn, nav-extension, nav-scan-history, download-extension-btn, extension-install-steps, history-pdf-<id>, ai-content-input/ai-content-analyze-btn, phishing-email-input/phishing-analyze-btn. Extension cannot be loaded in headless browser - zip validated via backend test only (per main agent note).
